items.title: First steps in programming
items.description: Started teaching myself to code as a teenager — YouTube, books, early pet projects that haven't survived to this day. That's when I realized I wanted to do this professionally.

items.title: B.Sc. Computer Science, with honors
items.description: Zaporizhzhia Polytechnic National University. Core focus: software architecture, full-stack web development, databases, algorithms & data structures, OOP.

items.title: University rated H+ in Anabin
items.description: My university is rated H+ in Anabin, Germany's database of foreign institutions — equivalent to a German university. Formal recognition (Anerkennung) of my specific degree is still ahead.

items.title: German B1 certified
items.description: Completed a BAMF integration course; passed the 'Leben in Deutschland' orientation test with a perfect score (33/33) — the same attention to detail I bring to code.

items.title: German B2 certified
items.description: Completed a profession-focused German language course targeting the German IT job market.

items.title: Bachelor's thesis: license plate recognition
items.description: Studied algorithms for license plate recognition under difficult weather conditions — my first deep dive into computer vision.

items.title: Open to full-time roles
items.description: Graduated with honors, having built a portfolio of production-grade projects alongside my studies. Open to full-stack opportunities and interviews.
